commands.name: translate
commands.notes: The existing command combines database matches, an external glossary and free-text translation; the Rust text routes are not output-compatible.

commands.name: search
commands.notes: The current Rust LIKE query is not equivalent to legacy global search: legacy searches enriched Basara, character, skill, item, aura and passive collections, returns complete data plus fuzzy scores, and applies uFuzzy ranking. This requires a dedicated library extraction rather than DTO normalization.

commands.name: db
commands.notes: Four queries match across legacy Azalee, the Rust CLI and native MCP. All three surfaces reject the same CTE mutation; the Rust library additionally verifies SQLite's prepared-statement readonly flag.

commands.name: redis
commands.notes: Fourteen output comparisons match across legacy Azalee, the Rust CLI and native MCP for missing values, JSON objects, arrays, raw strings, set, get and delete. Three TTL checks confirm the shared 3600-second expiry contract; the isolated temporary key is always deleted.

commands.name: glossary-rebuild
commands.notes: The glossary artifact and its ownership are still unresolved in PLAN.md.

commands.name: audit
commands.notes: The Rust library audits the normalized character mirror and the full canonical skill corpus used by legacy Azalee. All character and skill integrity counters match exactly through the Rust CLI and native MCP.

commands.name: test-variants
commands.notes: Variant verification has no reusable Rust library API. Legacy currently evaluates 5,399 grouped base characters and reports 5,251 passing / 148 failing; grouping the publication mirror by localized name yields only 5,269, so that mirror cannot serve as a complete replacement source.

commands.name: rag
commands.notes: Azalee editorial retrieval must remain separate from game-data retrieval.

commands.name: status
commands.notes: The shared read-only report matches legacy SQLite, Redis, git, process and system schemas through CLI and MCP. Stable values match exactly, volatile measurements are type/unit validated, and the gate observes zero Redis mutations.

commands.name: wave
commands.notes: The batch workflow has no shared Rust orchestration entry point.

commands.name: repair
commands.notes: Repair operations require explicit parity and rollback evidence.

commands.name: sync
commands.notes: Mirror synchronization remains host-specific Bun logic.

commands.name: compare

secondarySurfaces: nie-site POST /api/v1/regles/comparaison (related engine contract, not the same lookup function)

commands.notes: Four scenarios cover levels 1, 50 and 99 plus exact-ID resolution. Eight legacy/CLI/MCP comparisons match exactly. The shared Rust library now reconstructs canonical name groups, merged/sorted variants, playable raw movesets and enriched stats from the same corpora instead of inferring them from the publication mirror.

commands.name: chara
commands.notes: Rust query and rendering pieces are exposed through CLI and native MCP, but orchestration still lives in the binding and parity is unproved.

commands.name: dialogue
commands.notes: Four probes and seven records match across legacy Azalee, the Rust CLI and native MCP on the same story corpus. Text lookup, speaker-name filtering, exact speaker-ID filtering, source ordering, limits, multilingual fields and empty results are covered.

commands.name: skill
commands.notes: The Rust library owns legacy precedence across canonical main, passive and aura corpora. Exact game ID, internal code, multi-result main search, passive ID, aura ID, unique aura-name search and absent results match through CLI and native MCP.

commands.name: item
commands.notes: The shared Rust lookup consumes the enriched item payload already stored in the mirror. Exact ID, unique localized name, ambiguous 15-record selection list and absent-result branches match legacy Azalee through CLI and native MCP.

commands.name: team
commands.notes: The shared Rust lookup joins canonical team ordering from all-gamedata/teams.json with the final enriched payloads in the mirror. Exact ID, unique name, ambiguous ordered list and absent-result branches match through CLI and native MCP.

commands.name: random-team
commands.notes: Five scenarios and fifteen surface contracts validate formations, unknown-option fallback, bilingual element/playstyle aliases, exact SQL pool membership, staff roles, result schemas and counts. Seeded Rust CLI and MCP outputs are identical; legacy selection is validated by invariants because its Math.random sequence is intentionally unseeded.

commands.name: team-builder
commands.notes: Only list/show/calc over SQLite are ported and exposed through CLI/MCP; PostgreSQL add/delete/save and parity tests remain open.

commands.name: test
commands.notes: The pipeline test coordinator remains a Bun-host command.

commands.name: shell
commands.notes: No Rust Inacord REPL binds the shared operations yet.

commands.name: data
commands.notes: Its seven pipeline subcommands require individual library-first migrations.

commands.name: serve
commands.notes: The Bun headless server exposes 41 routes; Rust route parity is not yet measured.
